_note: Hostinger reads its build settings from the hPanel Node.js page, not from this file. This file is the checked-in record of what those settings must be, so a panel change that diverges from the repository is visible in review. scripts/check-manifest.mjs requires it to exist. If the panel and this file disagree, the panel wins at runtime and this file is wrong - fix it.
_buildPipeline: The host runs `npm install` then `npm run build`. npm runs the lifecycle scripts around build automatically, so `npm run build` is really: prebuild (scripts/ensure-prisma-client.mjs -> prisma generate) -> next build --webpack -> scripts/finalize-standalone.mjs -> postbuild (content validation, non-blocking). Nothing else needs to be added to the panel's build command.
_whyWebpack: next build --webpack is mandatory. Turbopack runs PostCSS in a node worker that must connect back over 127.0.0.1, which the host's build container blocks; the deploy panics on src/app/globals.css. See docs/ADR-0001-build-with-webpack.md.

_environmentNotes.DATABASE_URL: Must be ABSOLUTE. The generated standalone server calls process.chdir(__dirname), so a relative file:./db/*.db resolves inside .next/standalone - a directory the deploy pipeline replaces on every push. src/lib/paths.ts detects this and logs a warning, but set it correctly.
_environmentNotes.APP_DATA_DIR: Absolute directory for data that must survive a redeploy (database, uploads, backups). Defaults to the repository root when unset.
_environmentNotes.AUTH_SECRET: Minimum 32 characters. Generate with: openssl rand -base64 48. Never commit it.
_environmentNotes.HOSTNAME: Leave 0.0.0.0 so the host's reverse proxy can reach the app.

_postDeployNotes: Run once after the first successful deploy, from the repository root, with the same DATABASE_URL the app uses. `prisma migrate deploy` is the only safe way to provision production - never `migrate dev`, `db push` or `migrate reset`. Seeding is idempotent for exam types and RBAC; it must never be pointed at a database holding real user data without reading the script first.
